YANAMI.title: Yanami Anna
YANAMI.pages.INITIAL.description: Under a bright sky, Yanami leans on the railing and smiles. Three drifting lights settle before you, each carrying a different promise.
YANAMI.pages.DONE.description: Yanami waves once, and the rooftop light fades into quiet wind. What you chose remains in your hands.
YANAMI.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.ancient: You finally made it. The wind here is kinder.
YANAMI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Pick one. Regret is just another kind of seasoning.
YANAMI.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: Three lights, one choice. Don't blink too long.
YANAMI.talk.ANY.2-0r.ancient: If it tastes sweet now, check the bill later.
YANAMI.talk.ANY.4-0r.ancient: Take what you can carry. The sky keeps moving.
